Wokingham Borough Council - Matthewsgreen Community Centre (DN831703)
Clarification log, 6 November 2026

Q1. What level of rent does the Council expect?
A1. No expectations - please state within your bid.

Q2. Will the Council contribute to running costs?
A2. Utility costs only, calculated on the net occupied floor area adjusted for hours of use.

Q3. Will there be a schedule of condition?
A3. No, there is not a schedule of condition.

Q4. Is the sinking fund contribution fixed?
A4. Yes, GBP 2,500 per annum as set out in the Heads of Terms.
